decision: 0117 is a custom migration that refuses (RAISE) when certification_step_versions holds an application without the submittedOn key, a team with boolean declarations, or a team decision or dossier review whose independenceAttested is not true, and when certification_receipts holds a Case read without the paged exchange keys (nextCursor, sendings) or the release keys (validity, revisions, currentRevisionIndex, revisionRequired); it changes no schema
why: Both tables are immutable (0100 triggers) and nothing is deployed; the web now reads a command reply as a full Case read, and every receipt older than pagination (#1307) also predates the other keys, while embedded step values come from rows the step check covers

decision: The API team decision and dossier review parsers require the literal true attestation (types independenceAttested: true); declarations accept only confirmed, conflict or to_verify, in commands and stored rows alike
why: The commands already required the attestation, and no current client sends boolean declarations; one parser serves commands and stored rows, so a stored earlier shape now fails closed (500) instead of reading as not attested or as a converted boolean

decision: Keep the API command contract that omits an optional field (submittedOn, recommendedOn, onBehalf, impartialityAnalysis): the shared parser still stores null for an omission
why: The issue excludes command changes; omission is the current command shape for every optional certification field; 0117 guarantees no stored application lacks the key

decision: The web Case reader requires every key the API read emits: the literal true attestation, declaration states, submittedOn and recommendedOn (date or null), act attributions and their form reference (object or null), the impartiality analysis (object or null) and the release validity (object or null); parseCaseCommandReceipt is removed and a command reply is parsed as a Case read
why: These are the readers of records made before the fields existed, named in #1370 or sharing its helpers (actAttribution, impartialityAnalysis); the other optional fields already required presence; an unreadable reply leaves the save uncertain and retryable with the same key
evidence: #1370 AC1; certification-response.ts; certification-release.ts; CertificationWorkspace.tsx; certification-response.test.ts; CertificationWorkspace.exchanges.test.tsx
